_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. thenavia.com declares Relume --color-scheme-1 slots (cream page, ink text, chartreuse accent) and --_primitives---colors--* hues. The light set holds the roles the public site paints. Measured control sizes come from raw/components-computed.json. No dark theme is bound.

black.note: the var name carries a deleted Relume variable tombstone

lightest.note: the var name carries a deleted Relume variable tombstone

white.note: the var name carries a deleted Relume variable tombstone

heading.source: declared on :root in the Webflow stylesheet as --_typography---font-styles--heading; vars.mjs did not resolve it onto the probe element
heading.description: Lora, the display face. Computed fontFamily on hero-title matches this stack.

body.source: declared on :root in the Webflow stylesheet as --_typography---font-styles--body; vars.mjs did not resolve it onto the probe element
body.description: Public Sans, the UI face. Computed fontFamily on nav-link and submit matches this stack.

handwriting.source: declared on :root in the Webflow stylesheet as --_typography---font-styles--handwriting; vars.mjs did not resolve it onto the probe element
handwriting.description: Notemakersmark, declared for handwritten accents. No captured control computed this family.

small.source: declared on :root in the Webflow stylesheet as --_ui-styles---radius--small; vars.mjs did not resolve it onto the probe element
small.description: 0.25rem. Fields measure 4px, which is this step at 16px root.

medium.source: declared on :root in the Webflow stylesheet as --_ui-styles---radius--medium; vars.mjs did not resolve it onto the probe element

large.source: declared on :root in the Webflow stylesheet as --_ui-styles---radius--large; vars.mjs did not resolve it onto the probe element
large.description: 1rem. Declared. Primary buttons measure 64px, not this step.

computed type of contact-title default (raw/components-computed.json); the 64px contact h1
computed type of hero-title default (raw/components-computed.json); the 56px hero h1
computed type of section-title default (raw/components-computed.json); the 48px section h2
computed type of feature-item default (raw/components-computed.json); the 22.4px feature label
computed type of text-field default (raw/components-computed.json); the 16px field
computed type of nav-link default (raw/components-computed.json); the 16px nav label
computed type of submit default (raw/components-computed.json); the 16px submit label

notTokenised: text.muted: Not captured. No secondary text colour is declared; body uses --color-scheme-1--text.
text.disabled: Not captured. No disabled control was shown.
border.focus: Not captured. Measured focus-visible states did not paint a site-authored ring.
status.success, status.warning, status.danger, status.info: Not captured. The public site shows none.
color.dark: Not captured. prefers-color-scheme: dark still paints the cream page. html.dark resolves the same custom properties.

surface.description: The scheme-1 foreground, the same cream as the page.

accent.description: Chartreuse #e8ff39, the primary button fill on the marketing nav and hero.

accent-pressed.source: computed backgroundColor of submit hover (raw/components-computed.json): the orange submit inverts to ink. The chartreuse button's hover overlay was not isolated as its own token.
accent-pressed.description: Pressed/hover fill observed on the contact submit.

field.description: Contact field fill, the page cream.

orange.source: css-var --_primitives---colors--orange, also computed backgroundColor of submit default
orange.description: The contact submit and the contact-page nav button.

radius.description: Fields are 4px, the small radius step.

fill.description: The chartreuse fill painted on .button-base inside the nav and hero CTAs.

radius.source: computed borderRadius of .button-base inside the Get started anchor, read live on / on 2026-11-21 (the anchor itself is transparent)
